_annotation.what_this_is: Raw JSON-RPC 2.0 exchanges between mcp_agent.py (client/host) and mcp_server_claims.py (server). Hand-annotated field by field.
_annotation.where_model_call_happens: The model (Groq LLM) is called ONLY in mcp_agent.py inside run_mcp_agent() via client.chat.completions.create(). It does NOT happen in any MCP server. The servers expose data; the host runs inference.
_annotation.where_model_does_NOT_call: mcp_server_policy.py and mcp_server_claims.py never call an LLM. They return deterministic data — search results, claim records, payout calculations — via JSON-RPC. Placing an LLM inside a server would collapse the host/server separation that MCP enforces.

serverInfo.name: claims-system
serverInfo.description: Claims platform: claim status and adjuster note history by claim number

field_annotations.jsonrpc: Protocol version tag — always '2.0'. Required by JSON-RPC spec.
field_annotations.id: Correlation ID — client sets it; server echoes it so responses are matchable.
field_annotations.method: The RPC method name. MCP methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call.
field_annotations.params: Method arguments object. Schema depends on the method.
field_annotations.result: Successful response payload. Mutually exclusive with 'error'.
field_annotations.error: Error response payload {code, message}. Present only on failure.
field_annotations.protocolVersion: MCP protocol version the client requests. Server echoes or rejects.
field_annotations.clientInfo: Identifies the connecting client (name, version). Informational only.
field_annotations.capabilities: Feature flags the client/server advertise. {} = no special caps.
field_annotations.serverInfo: Server name and version, returned by initialize.
field_annotations.tools: Array of tool descriptors from tools/list.
field_annotations.name: Tool name string — unique identifier used in tools/call.
field_annotations.description: Human/LLM-readable prompt that guides when and how to call the tool.
field_annotations.inputSchema: JSON Schema of the tool's argument object — validated by the host.
field_annotations.content: Array of content blocks returned by tools/call.
field_annotations.text: The serialised tool result as a JSON string inside the text block.
field_annotations.isError: True when the tool returned an error. Lets the host mark it as failure.

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: Retrieve the full claim record — loss date, claimed amount, excess amount, policy form number, and adjuster notes — for a given claim number. Always call this FIRST to load the claim before searching exclusions or computing a payout. Claim numbers follow the format CLM-YYYY-nnnnn (e.g. CLM-2024-10001). If the number is not found the server returns the correct format so you can ask the caller to verify the number rather than guessing coverage.

claim_id.description: Claim identifier in CLM-YYYY-nnnnn format, e.g. CLM-2024-10001.

tools.name: get_adjuster_notes
tools.description: Retrieve only the adjuster note history for a claim, without the full financial record. Use this when you need to re-read notes to identify peril keywords (seepage, mold, earthquake, business pursuits) without re-loading all claim fields. Same format requirement as get_claim: CLM-YYYY-nnnnn.
